versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Removed the file weather_executor.txt.
- No changes to workflow or features; core functionality remains the same.

- Initial release of Weather Helper skill.
- Responds to user questions about weather, temperature, or clothing advice.
- Prompts for city if not provided by the user.
- Uses search tools to retrieve real-time weather data.
- Formats responses with temperature, weather condition, and tailored clothing suggestions.
- Ensures weather information is accurate and based on search results; informs users to check manually if search fails.
